dedupe_keys.name: daily erosion project wepp preparation workflow

description: The Daily Erosion Project repository contains Iowa State University's workflows for preparing local inputs to the Water Erosion Prediction Project model, running scenarios and presenting erosion results. It also publishes a dailyerosion Python library. Users supply weather, land and management files through the documented project layout; outputs are WEPP-ready inputs and processed erosion estimates for the selected area and period. Geographic coverage is tied to the locally configured watershed, with the project originating in Iowa. MIT source, code descriptions and package availability are public. The maintainers caution that the code assumes specific paths, including /opt/dep and a separate scenario-data store, and that much processing is project-specific. A limitation is that reuse elsewhere requires adapting those paths and validating local soil and management data. The workflow can support erosion and sediment scenarios affecting drainage or reservoir infrastructure. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis is a separate weather source. No input archive or package was downloaded.
